description: Create a new Security Case Note in OneUptime. Returns the created Security Case Note object with its ID. Use this to add new Security Case Notes to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

projectId.description: ID of the project this note belongs to.

securityCaseId.description: ID of the case this note is on.

name: create_security_case_note
title: Create Security Case Note
